heard: Three astronauts were suffocating inside a dying moon lander. It was like their spacecraft's lungs were slowly clogging up, poison gas, spiked because Jim Level's crew crowded a two-man ship. The command module had square filters, but the lander's holes were round. They were stranded 200,000 miles from Earth with zero spare parts. Mission control engineers built a fix using manuals and duct tape. This mailbox, made of manuals and plastic, saved their lives. It's the only reason those three astronauts didn't end up suffocating.
